items.prompt: Which statement is true for every rhombus?
hints: A rhombus is a slanted square with four equal sides.
Think of a square pushed over.
Which property stays when the square is pushed over?
items.explanation: A rhombus always has four equal sides and two pairs of parallel sides. The angles do not have to be right angles.

options.text: All four sides are equal and opposite sides are parallel

options.why: That is true for a square, but a rhombus can lean over.

options.text: The two diagonals are the same length
options.why: That is true for a rectangle, but not for every rhombus.

options.text: It has exactly one line of symmetry
options.why: A rhombus has two lines of symmetry along its diagonals.

items.prompt: How many edges does a hexagonal prism have? (Its two ends are hexagons.)
hints: Count the edges of the top face and the bottom face.
Do not forget the edges that join the top to the bottom.
items.explanation: The top hexagon has 6 edges, the bottom has 6, and 6 edges join them. 6 + 6 + 6 = 18 edges.

items.prompt: Citra draws the net of a cylinder with one rectangle and two circles. The long side of the rectangle must be equal to which measurement of the circle?
hints: The rectangle wraps around the curved side of the cylinder.
What part of a circle goes all the way around it?
items.explanation: The rectangle becomes the curved surface. It wraps once round the circle, so its long side equals the circumference.

options.why: The radius is only half-way across the circle, much too short to wrap around it.
The diameter goes across the circle once, but the rectangle wraps all the way round.
Area is measured in square units, not a length.

items.prompt: True or false: The diameter of a circle is twice its radius.
hints: Diameter goes across; radius goes to the centre.
items.explanation: The diameter goes all the way across, through the centre. The radius is half of it.

items.prompt: True or false: All parallelograms have four equal sides.
hints: Does a rectangle have four equal sides?
Only a rhombus has four equal sides.
items.explanation: A parallelogram has two pairs of parallel sides, but a rectangle that is not a square is a parallelogram with unequal sides.

items.prompt: True or false: A cube has 6 faces and 8 vertices.
hints: 4 on top and 4 on the bottom.
items.explanation: A cube has 6 square faces and 8 corners.
